Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, positive nitrites, and hematuria, with urine culture confirming >100,000 CFU/mL Proteus mirabilis, indicating a urinary tract infection. Low specific gravity may suggest dilute urine. No ketones or casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy based on sensitivity.
